- Food and Biological Systems

At Ford Health, drtoby@fordheath.com.au. , we believe that the common activity of all business workers is to make consistently good decisions under pressure every day. Ford Health is working with clients to expand our expertise and assistance in performance. We are also exploring resilience, which is how workers can be like our military and cope with pressure of combat everyday to be resilient and bounce back when under sustained demand.

How We Will Get There
For 15 years, our team have remained boutique in size, to be nimble and respond to trends.  We prefer to use our own staff who have specialised in this work as it guarantees better quality,consistency and accountability to our clients. To achieve national coverage, it means we use technology and move our consultants to a network of clinic sites.

Bio: People assume a CEO's career starts somewhere impressive. Mine started at a hotdog stand. I was 15, elbow deep in onions and sauce, selling hotdogs to brutally honest footie fans at North Sydney Oval. That stand taught me more about business than any textbook did. If the product isn't good, people don't come back. Feedback, especially the loud kind, is a gift. Sales can be predicted and influenced by timing, pricing and pace. And everyone has an opinion, even the person just buying a hotdog. I've always been ambitious. But I've never been ambitious instead of kind. I'm ambitious with people. My career since then has been less of a ladder and more of a plate of spaghetti. Frying eggs at 6am in a South Coast guesthouse. Cleaning toilets. Serving afternoon tea to a Prime Minister who stayed. That job taught me discipline and humility and how to talk to absolutely anyone. Then London. I went from a Sydney girls' private school bubble straight into government roles that took me into domestic violence scenes, suicides and crisis housing. Confronting doesn't cover it. But it gave me perspective, resilience and the understanding that you can't control everything. You can only control how you lead through it. That spaghetti eventually turned into results. I ran the government's first start up investment fund, helped raise over $200 million and backed founders building brands that became household names, Ink Gin among them (yes, the one Margot Robbie chose for her engagement party). I co-developed market leading financial products in government and engaged 500+ customers and channel partners in a single year at Jobs for NSW. In the private sector I doubled key corporate accounts in a brutally competitive market at Toll Group. I've also built businesses from nothing, as a founder in coffee retail and wholesale. Today, as CEO of Fitness Passport, my team and I have built Australia's largest wellness network. We've scaled from 30 people to over 100 and done it profitably. Profitability isn't a vanity metric to me. It means sustainability, reinvestment and long term value for the people who trust us, our employers, our facilities and our members. I care about building organisations with a clear purpose, a strong culture and results you can actually measure, without losing the human part of the equation. If you care about high performance teams, customer obsession, smart growth and doing good business that actually feels good, we'll get along. Hotdogs optional.

Company description:
We started UBX with one aim in mind: to give everyone the opportunity to train like a boxer. Our success has come from our ability to rethink boxing and rethink group training in a way that gives our members access to a unique mix of boxing and strength training in an ultra-flexible format that removes class timetables and bookings altogether. We like to think that we’re everything a traditional gym is not: fun, flexible, addictive and inclusive! 

Co-founded in Australia by four-time world champion boxer Danny Green and fitness entrepreneur Tim West, UBX now has over 100 boutique gyms across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, UK, Ireland, USA and Japan

WORLD-CLASS WORKOUTS //
Our workout delivers a unique mix of boxing and strength training across a 12 round circuit. Six of the rounds include boxing exercises, whether that’s bagwork or one-on-one padwork with a coach. The other six rounds include a combination of functional strength, cardio and conditioning movements. During a workout, you get one-on-one time with our coaches to work on form, technique and do pad-work. We use thousands of exercises in unlimited combinations to provide a new workout everyday. 

READY WHEN YOU ARE //
Our workouts work around your world. We meet you where you are, no matter your fitness level. Every day we train anyone from professional athletes looking to push themselves to the limits to new mums who are getting back into exercise.

We offer the ultimate flexibility so you can get the most out of your membership. Our flexible start times mean you don’t have to book ahead, plus you can mix up your workouts to include 1-on-1 support during Coached Hours, independent training during Extended Access or workout anytime, anywhere with our On Demand app.

Let’s get the gloves on and see what’s possible.

Bio:
I was the kid that always annoyed my parents with....another great business idea. 
 
So in 2008, when presented with the opportunity to purchase a rundown health club called Pinnacle, at age 22, I was prepared to put my savings on the line to take a risk.
 
Pinnacle was making a loss of $10K per month with only 400 members. Based on my limited working capital, I had 3 months to turn the club around and break even. With a new direction & clear focus I worked hard with some great team members to do just that.
 
Fast forward 13 years and Pinnacle had grown to 8000 members across 6 locations with benchmark yield per member. Our clubs continued to innovate and incorporated dedicated wellness and team training studios. We implemented a very successful tiered membership with integration of 28% of all members on an assisted training membership. In 2021 our chain was successfully acquired by VIVA leisure.
 
After 2 months of getting itchy feet I couldn’t keep my entrepreneur spirit tamed and in partnership with my wife Emma, Your Reformer was created. One of the skills I have developed and continue to improve is making ideas become profitable reality. I’m extremely proud to say that Your Reformer has quickly become Australia’s largest supplier of reformer Pilates beds for both the at home and commercial marketplace. I have loved every minute of leading our team, we have built a business that is making reformer Pilates accessible to more in the greater community. 
 
YR has now expanded into New Zealand, and I’m currently leading our international expansion plans.

Company description:
We started UBX with one aim in mind: to give everyone the opportunity to train like a boxer. Our success has come from our ability to rethink boxing and rethink group training in a way that gives our members access to a unique mix of boxing and strength training in an ultra-flexible format that removes class timetables and bookings altogether. We like to think that we’re everything a traditional gym is not: fun, flexible, addictive and inclusive! 

Co-founded in Australia by four-time world champion boxer Danny Green and fitness entrepreneur Tim West, UBX now has over 100 boutique gyms across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, UK, Ireland, USA and Japan

Our workout delivers a unique mix of boxing and strength training across a 12 round circuit. Six of the rounds include boxing exercises, whether that’s bagwork or one-on-one padwork with a coach. During a workout, you get one-on-one time with our coaches to work on form, technique and do pad-work. We use thousands of exercises in unlimited combinations to provide a new workout everyday.

Our workouts work around your world. We meet you where you are, no matter your fitness level. Every day we train anyone from professional athletes looking to push themselves to the limits to new mums who are getting back into exercise.

We offer the ultimate flexibility so you can get the most out of your membership. Our flexible start times mean you don’t have to book ahead, plus you can mix up your workouts to include 1-on-1 support during Coached Hours, independent training during Extended Access or workout anytime, anywhere with our On Demand app.

Let’s get the gloves on and see what’s possible.

i’m proud to be an element in the periodic table, my chemical symbol is K (which stands for kalium, my element name), my atomic number is 19! My oxidation states are +1, -1 (rare), I react with oxygen, water and carbon dioxide components in the air.
Some interesting facts about me are:
1. I am the seventh most abundant element in the earths crust! I’m also the eighth most abundant element in the human body. 7️⃣
2. I am found in many foods, including fruits like bananas!! 🍌 
3. I am an essential nutrient for life.
4. I burn in the flame test with a bright red colour using. When in water, the flame appears mauve.💜
5. I am also needed for plant growth 🍀
I am important because I am a mineral that is essential for all the body’s functions. It helps your nerves, muscles and heart to function well, and helps move nutrients and waste around your body’s cells.

Bio: I am a Sports Scientist and currently completing a Master of Clinical Exercise Physiology at Murdoch University. I am passionate about improving health, function and quality of life through evidence-based exercise, rehabilitation and person-centred care. Alongside my studies, I am the Director of Prosperiti Disability Services, where I work closely with participants, families and healthcare professionals to deliver high-quality disability support services that promote independence and meaningful community participation. I am also the Owner of Jetts Fitness Canning Vale, where I combine my passion for health, exercise and business leadership to create an inclusive environment that encourages people of all ages and abilities to improve their wellbeing through physical activity. My clinical training has provided experience in functional assessments, exercise prescription and rehabilitation for musculoskeletal injuries, chronic disease and occupational rehabilitation. I enjoy applying evidence-based exercise interventions to help people improve function, confidence and long-term health outcomes. My professional interests include: • Clinical Exercise Physiology • Exercise Rehabilitation • Disability Services and NDIS • Occupational Rehabilitation • Chronic Disease Management • Strength and Conditioning • Health Promotion • Functional Assessment My long-term goal is to combine clinical exercise physiology, disability services and business leadership to develop innovative rehabilitation services that improve health, independence and quality of life within the community. I enjoy connecting with healthcare professionals, exercise physiologists, allied health practitioners, support coordinators and others who are passionate about improving lives through movement, rehabilitation and evidence-based care.
